disqualifier.note: Notion paginated query wire at the driver boundary. collectPaginatedLinks treats !has_more as done and takes next_cursor only when has_more; that coherence check mirrors the Notion API contract rather than a domain-owned union.

Separate cluster from the seeded detached/locked/prunable porcelain tokens. branch vs detached copies git worktree list --porcelain (branch <ref> versus the detached token); exclusivity is the git wire contract.
Separate cluster from the seeded porcelain token booleans. applyPorcelainAttribute independently latches branch and detached from git tokens; the XOR is git's listing contract.
Separate cluster from the seeded doctor fact bag. doctor copies WorktreeListEntry.detached/branch from git porcelain; attached vs detached remains the upstream git contract.

NullOr(detached)+NullOr(branch) copies porcelain when an entry exists and both-null when enumeration missed the checkout. Attached vs detached is still git's wire; the extra null is unknown-measurement, not a domain-owned masked union.

Separate cluster from the seeded hasProjectTsconfig/hasDocgenConfig pair. hasProjectTsconfig is the tsconfig.json probe; ownerTsconfigPath is chooseOwnerTsconfig's build-or-project winner. hasProject implying owner is the tautology that project json is one owner candidate; combined-true is the normal package.
Independent CLI axes: apply selects dry-run vs retire, json selects encoded report output. All four combinations are legal.

probeFailed is the OR of child branch-diff/policy probes and does not restate mergeBase presence. unmeasuredSignals writes mergeBase null with probeFailed false; MERGE_BASE_PROBE_FAILED writes null+true; child failure writes some+true; success writes some+false. All four presence combos occur.

Independently observed filesystem facts: directory vs optional mtime. A directory can lack mtime and a file can have one; UNREADABLE both-false collides with a no-mtime file rather than masking a union.
